title: A legal cap on rents
detail: Cap rents by law (*topar alquileres*). No formula or percentage is given.
c: No formula; rent caps are already possible under the Housing Law, but only once the region declares a stressed area, and the Galician government (PP) does not.

title: Automatic lease renewal; no evictions of vulnerable people
detail: Stability for tenants through automatic renewal (*renovación automática*) of contracts, action against abuse and speculation, and a ban on evicting (*desahucio*) people in vulnerable situations.
c: As with Sumar and Bildu: realistic if landlords are compensated.

title: Stop homes turning into tourist and seasonal lets
detail: Measures against turning main homes into seasonal, room or tourist lets. Homes built with public money stay public for good.
c: Almost everyone supports closing the seasonal-let loopholes; a ban on selling social housing is realistic.
pos: More homes for residents and less pressure from tourism.
neg: Lost tourism income; a ban on selling social housing takes flexibility away from owner families.

title: Retirement at 65, partial pension from 61, calculated on 10 years
detail: Restore 65 as the ordinary retirement age (*edad ordinaria de jubilación*), partial retirement from 61 and a 10-year calculation period (*periodo de cómputo*).
c: 65 for all, partial retirement from 61 and a 10-year calculation period (25 today) would reverse the 2011–2013 reforms; in our estimate, +1.5–2.5% of GDP a year by 2040.

title: 35-hour week with no pay cut
detail: Move towards a 35-hour working week with no pay cut (*sin reducción salarial*). No deadline.
c: Even 37.5 hours failed in 2025; no deadline is given.

s.t: Congress, BOCG 15-A-58-3: 37.5-hour bill returned to the government (10 Sep 2025)

title: Recognise Galicia as a nation in a plurinational state
detail: Seek recognition of Galicia as a nation with national rights, moving towards a plurinational state (*Estado plurinacional*) that respects its nations' right to decide.
c: Recognising a nation with a right to decide requires constitutional reform under art. 168.
